title: Unbounded Leray isomorphism for evaluation on ringed sites
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})$ and $(\mathcal D,\mathcal O_{\mathcal D})$ be ringed sites, small relative to the common module universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with sheaves of commutative rings. Let $f$ be a morphism of ringed sites inducing a morphism of ringed topoi [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] and corresponding to a continuous functor $u:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, so module direct image has underlying sections $(f_*M)(V)=M(u(V))$, with scalar action induced by $\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}(V)\to\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}(u(V))$. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $V\in\mathcal D$ and $E\in D(\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})$, there is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$ R\Gamma(V,Rf_*E)\;\cong\;R\Gamma(u(V),E)\qquad\text{in }D(\operatorname{Ab}). $$
Here $R\Gamma(T,-)$ means the total right derived functor of evaluation at the site object $T$, followed by forgetting scalars, and all total right derived functors are computed on K-injective resolutions (every map from an acyclic complex to a K-injective complex is null-homotopic). The isomorphism is natural in $E$ and compatible with restriction along maps of $V$. No boundedness, quasi-coherence or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0D6H (lemma-Leray-unbounded), second assertion; after forgetting the induced section-ring action.

proof.text: Apply the sectionwise resolution lemma to a K-injective replacement j of f_*I. Naturality of the derived-evaluation unit at j, invertibility of its value on the K-injective target, and invertibility of the localized j(V) imply that the evaluation unit on f_*I is invertible. Consequently the composite derived unit for Rf_* followed by derived evaluation is invertible on every K-injective I.

source.place: Tag 0D6H (lemma-Leray-unbounded), proof of the second assertion; Tags 0D6G and 0D6E.

proof.text: The K-injective right derivability structure shows that the composite functor with its composite unit is a total right derived functor of evaluation at u(V). Uniqueness of total right derived functors yields its canonical isomorphism with the existing derived evaluation. The factorization equation is the asserted unit normalization. Restriction compatibility follows by derived-natural-transformation unit equations, naturality with respect to the direct-image unit, and the sectionwise identity between the target restriction and the source restriction at u(v).

source.place: Tag 0D6H (lemma-Leray-unbounded), proof of the second assertion; Tags 0D6G and 0D6E.

proof.text: Two normalized comparisons have equal inverse components on every K-injective I: cancel the invertible evaluation unit in their normalization equations. The inclusion of K-injectives in the derived category is essentially surjective. Transport along its object isomorphisms and apply natural-transformation and isomorphism extensionality to obtain equality of the families.
